sentences.text:
This is third application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 (Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No.149 of 2024, dated 25.02.2024 registered at Police Station- Police Chowki Madwas Majhouli District- Sidhi (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376,
450 of IPC.

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 25.02.2024.

Applicant's first bail application (M.Cr.C No.13377 of 2024) was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 12th April, 2024 and second bail application (M.Cr.C No.24063 of 2024)
was also dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after prosecutrix evidence before the trial court vide order dated 5th July, 2024.

As per the prosecution story, on 25.02.2024 at around 1.00 PM 28 years old prosecutrix lodged FIR about commission of rape with her by the applicant.
After investigation, the charge sheet has been filed.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix is major and mother of four children.

sentences.text: It is further contended that prosecutrix has also been examined before the trial court.
Therefore, on the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
5 . Prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial court.
Prosecutrix and applicant both are major.
Now there is no possibility of influencing of the prosecution witnesses or tempering with the prosecution evidence.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the detention period of the applicant but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am deem it fit to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, this bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) for grant NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45930 3 MCRC-38706-2024 of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Suresh Kushwaha be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C/480(3) of BNSS, 2023.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
